problem: Production English routes existed but could fall back to the runtime translation endpoint because the deterministic static cache was incomplete after new AI-ecosystem copy was added. The runtime translator was simultaneously returning 502 translation_failed.
root_cause: 119 newly introduced public source strings were not added to the canonical config/bg-static-i18n-en.d cache lineage. The fail-closed validator correctly detected the gap, but the deployed production commit predated the completed cache and therefore emitted English routes with data-bg-static-translated=false.
prevention: Every public copy change must update the canonical config/bg-static-i18n-en.json or config/bg-static-i18n-en.d fragment in the same candidate lineage.
Never restore .cache as production translation authority.
STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 node tools/site-shell/build-localized-routes.mjs --validate-cache must pass before protected delivery.
All public /en routes must be statically translated so a runtime provider outage cannot break initial public language switching.
Production browser proof must still exercise NL to EN to NL and verify visible English state.
